E1.copy: The next Skill Bingo hasn't been scheduled yet.
E1.recovery: Keep the draft; refresh automatically while the page remains open, or return later

E2.copy: This event link has expired. Scan the event QR code again.

E3.copy: We couldn't load your role options.

E5.copy: Registration for this round is closed. Your board is saved for the next round.

E6.copy: Your latest skill wasn't saved. Try again.

E7.recovery: Replace local time with server time

E8.copy: This round is already in progress. Your board will join the next round.

E9.copy: You don't have permission to control this event.

E10.copy: The round changed before this action completed. Mission Control has been refreshed.

E11.copy: No eligible skills remain. End or cancel this round.

E13.copy: Your Soul is ready, but couldn't launch yet.

E14.copy: Sound is unavailable on this device.

E15.copy: This round was cancelled. Your board is saved for the next round.

E16.copy: Choose your Platform and Role to start building your board.
E16.recovery: Keep skill selection unavailable until both are explicitly selected

E17.copy: We couldn't load the Skill Master. Your selections are safe.
E17.recovery: Preserve the draft and retry loading

E18.copy: We couldn't build your board yet. Your 16 skills are saved.
E18.recovery: Retry server randomization; do not accept client positions

E19.copy: The round couldn't finish locking. Player edits are closed.
E19.recovery: Keep the prior version, reject edits after lock_at, and let the admin retry or cancel

E20.copy: This round needs at least five eligible skills before it can start.
E20.recovery: Keep the round locked; reschedule or cancel

E21.copy: The next skill wasn't drawn. Try again.
E21.recovery: Commit and publish nothing; retry with the same idempotency key

E22.copy: Your Soul is still forming. We'll keep trying.
E22.recovery: Retry idempotently and keep the result view available

E23.copy: Round complete. No Bingo this time.
E23.recovery: Close the round and show the next-round Waiting state

E24.copy: Please rephrase your message. Links, contact details and rude words can't go on the big screen.
E24.recovery: Keep the text so the player can edit or clear it, then float again
